# Draft:Heat Warden®️ Heat Deflectors for Fire Pits

Heat Warden®️is the brand for American Made Fire Pit Heat Deflectors. The Heat Deflector consists of a 304 Stainless Steel Heat Deflector with foldable steel legs and additional Stainless Steel Side Shields. The purpose of the Heat Warden®️Heat Deflector is to capture the heat of fire pits in order to distribute the heat out instead of up to keep folks warms. The Heat Deflectors come in various sizes and shapes including square, round, and rectangle. The company also makes Made in USA Stainless Steel Heating Logs to add radiant heat. The Heat Warden®️name is trademarked and the Heat Warden®️Heat Deflector received a United States patent on January 2, 2024.
